parameters.diagnostics: Extreme shifts can hide resonator intent

parameters.usage: Low bands = size, mids = material, highs = air
parameters.diagnostics: Too many bands can blur pitch
High feedback can cause metallic ring

automation_guidance: Automate damping for expressive brightness changes.
Automate noise rate for bow pressure changes.
Automate resonator feedback for body emphasis shifts.
Automate main ADSR release for performance tails.

validation.mono_check: Always evaluate mono after spread changes.
validation.attack_focus: If attack is wrong, return to Touch before adjusting resonance.
